items.text: "So. It is $P. Long he lay in the village of the Kuraks, smashed when @Darden took @Aiela away.&
"Now he comes before the chief of the Kuraks, and has rescued Aiela, daughter of the chief. The chief is pleased to welcome his friend $P.&
"Now he has regained his strength, and comes before the chief of the Kuraks. What does he want?&
"Ah, it is $P, rescuer of Aiela! You are a welcome guest here. What may Aloron help $P with?&
"Why does $P come before Aloron again when he has not rescued Aiela? What does he want?&
"$P is welcome in the village of the Kuraks.&
"$P speaks to Aloron, father of @Aiela.&
Aiela runs over to embrace her father briefly. "$P has come home with me to visit my father.&
"This warrior is chief of the Kurak tribe. He leads the Kurak warriors against the @Myrmidex and the @Yolaru.&
Prof. Rafkin whispers in your ear: "Among the @Yolaru, with whom I lived, Aloron was well-known and respected. He's supposed to be an honest and forthright chieftain.&
"There are many tribes in this valley. We are the Kuraks. There are also the @Yolaru, the Disquiqu, and the Nahuatla in their stone village.&
"Further away, there are Pindiro and Barako in the far north, Jukari and ugly Haakur in the southeast, Barrab and lizard-Sakkhra in southwest.&
"Hidden away somewhere southeast are the @Urali.&
The chieftain smiles. "Aloron is grateful to $P for rescuing his daughter Aiela.&
The chieftain sighs unhappily. "Aloron's daughter Aiela, flower of his life, has been taken away. Aiela is held by @Darden the Huge, the chieftain of the @Urali.&
"Many Kurak warriors search the land for the hidden Urali, to bring Aiela back. Aloron hopes that you join in the search.&
"If $P were to find Aiela, Aloron would be most grateful.&
"If $P wants bones, he should go east of the Kurak village until he reaches the @Yolaru village. From there, he must go south, keeping the cliff ever to his left.&
"Soon, he will find the place where the big lizards go to die.&
"If $P wants bamboo, he must travel south of the place of many @bones.  There he will find a stand of bamboo.&
"The Yolaru are a tribe to the east of the Kuraks. Their chief is Apaton.&
Aloron scowls at his daughter. "Aiela is friends with them, with the shaman's daughter Sahree. Aiela is a disobedient child sometimes.&
Aiela speaks up, indignant: "Aiela sometimes knows better than her father what is good for the Kuraks.&
"While Kuraks war with Yolaru, while all tribes war with all others, the @Myrmidex will always be able to defeat all the tribes.&
"Aiela and her friend Sahree know that the tribes must @unite against the Myrmidex... even if their fathers do not know this yet.&
The chief merely snorts.
"Myrmidex. Giant warrior-insects. They live very close, to the west of the Kurak village. They raid here all the time, killing and eating.&
"The Kurak are the greatest warriors in all the valley. But the Myrmidex are... other than human.&
"Mighty beyond belief, in their numbers and ferocity. The Kuraks fall before them.&
Aiela breaks in: "My father, Aiela is certain that the Kuraks would defeat the Myrmidex if only we would @unite with the @Yolaru and other tribes...&
The chief frowns. "The @Yolaru are enemies of the Kurak. Enemies, always. Not worth befriending.&
"Topuru was the shaman of the @Urali long ago. Topuru went mad; Aloron does not know why. Somewhere in the far, far north, Topuru lives on a little island.&
"Aloron no longer needs to visit vengeance upon the Urali. Aloron has his daughter back.&
"The Urali often raid Kurak territory. They come from the southeast somewhere, but we can not find their village.&
"Aloron has heard of one who might know. A mad warrior named @Topuru.
"The @Urali were a peaceful tribe until Darden the Huge became chief. Only then did they begin to raid others.&
"Does $P speak of uniting all the tribes of the valley?&
"$P is in the village of the Kurak tribe.&
"$P speaks of the Great Drum of legend. In ancient past, the warrior Oloro-of-No-Tribe built a great drum on a hill near the stone village of the Nahuatla.&
"If $P wants to @unite the tribes, he should build new Great Drum there.&
"$P may always speak to Aloron. $P rescued Aiela from savage Urali men.&
"Fare well, $P. Go, join the warriors searching for @Aiela. Try to find @Aiela.&
"Hmph.& Disinterested, he turns away from you.
"$P has brought smiles to Aiela's eyes. He may count himself Aloron's friend in all things.&
"But $P must not count himself friend of Aloron. He has cruelly treated Aiela.&
Prof. Rafkin breaks in, indignantly: "Now, now, my fur-covered fellow, I must protest. I lived among the @Yolaru for some time and found them to be a most delightful people.&
"Were you to befriend them, you might find them as gallant a race as your own Kuraks.&
The chief merely grimaces and waves him away.
"Then Aloron does not know of what $P speaks.&
"Aloron has already told $P how to enlist the aid of the Kuraks: Rescue Aiela. If he wishes to enlist the aid of other chiefs, he must get each to promise his aid, and must build the Great @Drum.&
He thinks about this for a long time.
Finally: "Aloron thinks $P is mad with the sun. The tribes of the valley like making war on one another. It is the way they have lived since before memory.&

"But once before it was done: There is the story of Oloro-of-No-Tribe, a mighty warrior. When the mighty lizards grew too many in number, Oloro went from chief to chief, taking from each a promise to help, to stop making war.&
"When all chiefs had made their promise, Oloro built a Great Drum on the small hill north of the Nahuatla city. From there, he summoned the chiefs and the warriors to march on the lizards.&
"If $P wishes to unite the tribes of the valley, he will find it a mighty task.&
"But Aloron will help. $P has rescued Aloron's daughter Aiela. $P can count on the aid of the Kuraks.&
"Does $P want to enlist the aid of the Kuraks in this way? He must rescue Aiela to do so. Aiela is held by the @Urali of @Darden the Huge.&
"If $P can rescue her, Aloron will join $P's alliance of tribes.&
Jimmy whips out his notebook. "I've got the gist of all that in my @notebook here, Mr. Adventure. Jimmy Malone never forgets.&
Jimmy speaks up. "Tell you what, boss. It could be that we're going to have a lot of these little chores ahead of us. I'll note down what each chief wants.&
"Any time you want to check out what we've got in store for us, ask me about my @notebook. It never forgets.&

description.text:
a lean, sharp-eyed, dignified black warrior.
*

items.text: He says nothing, but looks at you expectantly, waiting for you to begin speaking.
His face breaks into a smile. "Ah. $P addresses the chief of the Yolaru. $P is most welcome. Come, speak to Apaton.&
He looks at you coldly for a moment. "It is $P, who tries to cheat Apaton by offering too few weapons. What does $P want now?&
He nods at you, a cool greeting, and waits.
"Apaton.& He indicates himself.
"Chief of @Yolaru tribe.&
"As @schweitzer knows.& He points at Prof. Rafkin.
"Good day, great Apaton. Be nice to my friend $P, for he's a very good man, even if he's sloppy, forgetful, thoughtless, and a poor student.&
The chieftain blinks impassively and turns back to you.
"Yolaru tribe. We say little, do much. We fight the @Myrmidex and the @Kuraks.&
"Kurak tribe. Live west of Yolaru. Good fighters. Kuraks have better weapons than Yolaru. Yolaru are better fighters.&
"South of village, past @bones.&
"@Barrab tribe has blue stone.&
"Far southwest, land of mesas.&
"South of village, near cliffs.&
"Kill beast, use knife on carcass.&
"King of Nahuatla.&
"Former chief of Nahuatla. Exile hiding in jungle.&
"Fierce ants grown huge. Enemy of all.&
"Apaton has promised to help destroy Myrmidex. $P brought weapons for Yolaru.&
"Apaton already promised to help destroy Myrmidex -- if $P will bring ten Nahuatla swords to Yolaru.&
"They destroy Yolaru and others. Cannot be stopped.&
Prof. Rafkin nudges you. "The chief well knows who I am, my boy.& He turns to the chief. "By the way, your greatness, I will be travelling with $P for awhile.&
"No. Schweitzer must stay in village.&
"Perhaps you would prefer it if I turned you and all your warriors into tree-toads?&
"Schweitzer is ordered to travel with $P.&
"Schweitzer is like shaman, wiser in other ways. True name is hard to say: Raffa-Kin. Is probably in village.&
"Mad @Urali. No friend of Urali tribe, or any other. Lives in far north somewhere, on island.&
"Raiders. Come from southeast. Apaton does not know where.&
He thinks a moment. "@Topuru would know where Urali live.&
"@Urali did not raid other tribes until Darden the Huge became their chief.&
He gestures around him. "@Yolaru tribe.&
"Speak of uniting tribes? Making allies of enemies?&
"$P has already made allies of Yolaru. $P must go to other tribes to make allies of them.&
"$P may return whenever $P wishes.&
He turns away from you.
"Apaton does not understand.&
He just waits there, looking as though you'd said something stupid.
"Has $P brought weapons for Yolaru?&
"Do not speak of making allies of Yolaru until ten Nahuatla swords are brought to Yolaru. Apaton has spoken of this already: Yolaru need weapons to fight lizards and Myrmidex.&
He looks over your possesions...
Finding no swords, he glares at you angrily. "$P has no Nahuatla swords! Do not play games with Apaton. Return again, when you carry ten Nahuatla swords.&
He looks over the collection of weapons you've brought, counting them; as he counts them, he hands them out to Yolaru warriors as they walk past him.
As he finishes counting out the swords to his warriors, a look of anger suffuses his face.
"$P has only brought #0 Nahuatla sword\s to Apaton! $P is either slow to count or thinks to fool Apaton.&

"Apaton is no fool. $P has insulted him. $P must pay. Apaton will keep the #0 sword\s, and $P must still go forth and bring him 10 Nahuatla swords. Not #2: Another 10. Else Apaton will never join $P's union of tribes.&
"Go! And do not return without the promised weapons!&
He draws back, an expression of satisfaction crossing his face. "It is done. The weapons are in the hands of the Yolaru. And the Yolaru will join in $P's union of the tribes.&
"Ah.&
"Why?&
He thinks about it. "Good enough reason to stop noble wars?& He shrugs. "Apaton might consider this... but only to benefit whole tribe.&
He frowns. "'Because' is reason for children, and to give to children. Apaton asks again: Why?&
"Apaton does not understand reason. But Apaton might still do this, become allied with enemies -- if he can help whole tribe to do so.&
"Yolaru once had master weapon-maker in tribe. But weapon-maker died in Myrmidex raid. Now, we make fewer, poorer weapons.&
"To defend against Myrmidex, against giant lizards, Yolaru need weapons. He who brings weapons to Yolaru will earn friendship of Yolaru.&
"Go to Nahuatla, who make fine weapons. Bring us ten Nahuatla swords.&
"Come to Apaton with these weapons and speak again of uniting tribes. Then Yolaru will help against Myrmidex. Not before.&
Jimmy whips out his notebook. "Weapons. Got it. Now you've got me gun-running, $P-old-pal. Thanks a bunch.& He notes down Apaton's demand in his @notebook.
Jimmy speaks up. "Tell you what, boss. It could be that we're going to have a lot of these little chores ahead of us. I'll note down what each chief wants.&
"Any time you want to check out what we've got in store for us, ask me about my @notebook. It never forgets.&

description.text:
a sharp-faced but beautiful woman in Aztec dress.
*

items.text: "Blessings of the spirits on you!"
"You have returned. Perhaps you will choose to @trade for some of my weapons."
"I am Atlipacta."
"I am a crafter of weapons and armor."
"Perhaps you would care to @trade for some of my crafts."
"This is Tichticatl, the city of the Nahuatla."
"Yes, I have many fine weapons to @trade."
"I @trade both leather shields and armor."
"Emeralds are valuable to me. I will trade both weapons and shields for them."
"Yes, I used to @trade for blue stones from the southwest.  Now I only need @emeralds."
"I do not trade for $Z."
"I have heard of a drum-maker named Tuomaxx. He lives on a hill north of Tichticatl somewhere."
"Our king is Moctapotl. He was until recently in exile, but his usurper, Huitlapacti, has been cast down. Nor will I miss Huitlapacti."
She starts, and looks nervous. "I do not know that name. NO ONE knows that name in Tichticatl now. Perhaps you should leave."
"I have never seen the Myrmidex. I know they are fierce. I know I would wish to be wearing my own armor when facing them."
Her voice is sharp: "Don't speak his name to me! That vile madman had my own @brother killed."
Her expression and voice become carefully neutral. "All hail the king," she says dully.
"Yes, my brother was one of Huitlapacti's guards. One day, Huitlapacti hadn't had his fill of killing, and had no more victims..."
"So he had his guards draw lots to see who would die next. It was my brother."
"I do not know what you are saying."
"Yes, I @trade in that."
"May the spirits guide you on your path. Do return when you are in need of a well-made weapon!"
"I do not know what you are saying."

"I have @bows, @arrows, @knives, @swords, @armor and @shields for trade.
Which would you like?"

"I'll take
two emeralds for
a bow.
How many would you like?"

"I'll trade you
a dozen arrows for
one emerald.
How many dozens would you like?"

"I'll give you
one knife for
one emerald.
How many would you like?"

"I'll trade you
one sword for
three emeralds.
How many would you like?"

"I'll take
three emeralds for
one set of leather armor.
How many would you like?"

"I'll take
one emerald for
a shield.
How many would you like?"
"Nothing of interest? Perhaps you will need fine weapons later."
Would you like something else?"
"You can't afford #0 bow\s.

She takes #1 emerald\s from you and gives you #0 bow\s.
"
"You couldn't carry #0 bow\s.
"I do not have that many arrows!"
"You can't afford #0 arrow\s.

She takes #1 emerald\s from you and gives you #0 arrow\s.
"
"You couldn't carry that many arrows.
"You can't afford #0 kni/fe\ves.

She takes #1 emerald\s from you and gives you #0 kni/fe\ves.
"
"You couldn't carry #0 kni/fe\ves.
"You can't afford #0 sword\s.

She takes #1 emeralds from you and gives you #0 sword\s.
"
"You couldn't carry #0 sword\s.
"You can't afford that much armor.

She takes #1 emeralds from you and gives you #0 set\s of armor.
"
"You couldn't carry that much armor!
"You can't afford #0 shield\s.

She takes #1 emerald\s from you and gives you #0 shield\s.
"
"Sorry, you can't carry that much.

description.text:
a somber man wearing shamanistic face-paints.
*

items.text: "This one is tending a very @sick boy, and humbly begs that all visitors remain soft of voice."
"Balakai welcomes noble $P, hero of the Barrab, savior of young Nakai."
"This one sees that someone here is hurt."
"This one sees that someone here is hurt."
He springs up eagerly: "Has the noble visitor $P brought medicine for Nakai?"
"Balakai welcomes his most noble guest $P."
"This one is addressed by the name Balakai."
"This one is chief to the Barrab tribe, and also shaman."
"Balakai has heard of one named Shamuru, but does not know him."
"What do you mean by '$Z'?"
"Balakai belongs to the Barrab tribe."
"Nearby, to the west, are the @Sakkhra; they are not men, but reptiles shaped as warriors."
"Far to the east are the Disquiqui; the Barrab trade with them. Balakai once fought a duel with one of them, called @Tuomaxx the Drum-Maker."
"Much further east, there is a tribe called Urali. Balakai has only met one of them, a shaman called @Topuru."
"Somewhere far away are the @Myrmidex."
"You are among the Barrab, dwellers on the mesa."
"Yes, Barrab dwell on mesa. To north are two other mesas. One is too small to live on, and we cannot reach the @Great Mesa."
"Nakai is no longer sick, thanks to $P."
"Balakai's son Nakai is very ill. The illness is beyond Balakai's ability to cure. There is a @medicine which will cure his fever..."
"Nakola is very shy.  She is probably hiding while strange $P is here."
"The visitor wishes to hear the story of the blue stone?"
"Sakkhra live to the west, in the caves where this one used to find his @blue stones. Their king is called @Sysskarr."
"Is there a need for healing?"
"Is there a need for healing?"
"There is a giant flower with pale petals. Balakai thinks that the @roots of the flower will cure Balakai's son of the fever."
"But it has all but vanished. The last any member of the Barrab saw of it was on the @Great Mesa."
"Does the noble visitor wish to hear the story of Topuru?" He seems amused.
"Balakai does not understand the words of his visitor."
"The Great Mesa is northwest of here. Once there was a span of land from it to the small mesa to its south..."
"... but that fell many years ago. Now there is no way for me to reach the Great Mesa."
"Balakai knows of a drum-maker called Tuomaxx. A member of the Disquiqui tribe."
"One of the Barrab warriors had sent many warriors of the Disquiqui into flight, and Tuomaxx came for revenge."
"This one," he indicates himself, "confronted Tuomaxx and duelled him."
"Though Balakai received many poking fingers from Tuomaxx, he convinced Tuomaxx that he had removed Tuomaxx' mind and placed it in a @blue stone. And Tuomaxx believed."
"Tuomaxx was so delighted to be free of human intelligence that Tuomaxx thanked Balakai and left."
"That is tribal business. Unless... his visitor were willing to do a favor for Balakai."
"If the noble visitor were to go and find some @medicine for Balakai's @sick son Nakai, this one would tell his visitor all about the drum-maker Tuomaxx."
"It is the roots of the large pale flower that act as medicine. Chop it down, and bring the roots back to Balakai, and I may make Nakai well again."
"Balakai has seen them in his dreams. Balakai fears the Myrmidex. They are so fierce, and all fight as one."
"Balakai has had many @dreams about the Myrmidex."
"In his dreams, Balakai has seen a warrior from some distant tribe. The warrior comes and @unites the tribes against the Myrmidex."
"Does the noble visitor speak of uniting the tribes?"
"The Sakkhra king is called Sysskarr. A mighty fighter."
"When Balakai was but a stripling youth, and Sysskarr was a cunning, experienced warrior, they fought. They fought all day and all night."
"Balakai was fortunate enough to defeat Sysskarr. He thought Sysskarr must have died from grievous wounds, but Sysskarr survived and leads the Sakkhra still."
"There is always hospitality here for noble visitors."
"Balakai does not understand the words of his visitor."
"The tribes might not wish to be united."
"Doubtless the noble visitor has other ambitions."
"This one is in his visitor's debt for curing Nakai. When the noble visitor wishes this one's aid, he will have it."
"Balakai would be willing to help... if only his visitor could find the @medicine Balakai needs to cure his @sick son."
Jimmy whips out his @notebook and scribbles in it. "I've got that. YOU don't need to learn how to read with Jimmy around."
Jimmy speaks up. "Tell you what, boss. It could be that we're going to have a lot of these little chores ahead of us. I'll note down what each chief wants."
"Any time you want to check out what we've got in store for us, ask me about my @notebook. It never forgets."
"As shaman, this one may heal those who have suffered harm."
"It is fortunate that no one is unwell."
The shaman throws back his head and takes a deep breath... seeking knowledge from the spirits.
"No one here suffers injury."
"No one here is grievously wounded."
The shaman opens his eyes. "No one here is in need of healing."
The shaman's breathing becomes quicker... and a hard wind whips across you.

"Spirit of Kukuzz, $N invokes you to bestow a blessing upon $Y!"
... and $Y is healed!
"Mighty Spirit Kukuzz, look upon the mortal $Y. That which $Y carries is a valued friend and ally."
"$N beseeches Kukuzz, bestow the blessing of strength and health to $Y, so that $Y might walk and fight again!"

The wind howls, a raging torrent, around you...
Every hair on your body stands on end...
And the wounds disappear from $Y's body! $Y's eyes open!
The shaman examines the body sadly. "The spirits do not respond... there is nothing Balakai can do."
Taking the body the body from you, he says "Balakai will have this buried with proper respect."
The wind dies down, and the shaman slumps where he stands. After a moment, he looks up, exhausted.
"The spirits have been generous," he says. "All are well."
"Many years in the past, a shaman named @Topuru challenged Balakai to a contest of magic."
"Long and fierce was the competition. Topuru would demonstrate great powers; Balakai would demonstrate great powers."
"But Balakai could see that Topuru was strained of mind. So this one tricked Topuru. Balakai summoned his daughter @Nakola."
"Nakola knew well what to do. Balakai produced a piece of @blue stone and invoked the name of a spirit who does not exist."
"Nakola soon began to gibber, and Balakai told Topuru that he had ripped her mind from Nakola and put it in the stone."
"Then, because Balakai was angry, he repeated the ceremony upon Topuru. Topuru believed that his mind was placed into a rock."
"Balakai told him that the rock would be smashed if ever Topuru annoyed any of the Barrab. Topuru went far, far away."
"One could cure @Topuru by giving him ANY @blue stone, for no stone truly holds his mind."
"If the noble visitor wishes to have some of the rock, he must visit the Sakkhra caves."
"There is a large stone there; strike it with a hammer, and small pieces will break off."
"So sad. It is an amusing tale."
"Yes? Quickly, let Balakai see!"
He sighs and slumps back. "So. Ever Balakai's son draws closer to death, and there is no hope for him without @medicine."
He waits....
"Balakai has been cruelly lied to. While his son lies dying, his visitor makes jests. Jests!"
"The visitor is invited to leave, and not return until he has brought the medicine to save young Nakai."
With trembling fingers, he takes the root.
Working quickly, he grinds it into a cup, adds water, and says a quick prayer over the mixture.
He carefully trickles the fluid into his son's mouth, waiting patiently as his son swallows.
Even as you watch, the boy's color improves... and within a few minutes his eyes open.
"Father? This one is very cold."
"Nakai has been ill. Lie back and rest, Nakai."
He turns back to you, beaming. "Balakai is unable to express his gratitude for $P's aid. $P may come and go freely through Barrab lands."
"How fortunate."

description.text:
a short, scowling, black-haired, drunken native man.
*

items.text: "Oh, YOU again."
"Oh... a wise man, eh?"
"All the time I was locked up by these Disquiqui, I had the weird feeling I'd seen this guy somewhere before..."
He whacks you with a wooden spoon. "Chafblum did not tell you to speak. Now Chafblum will never tell you his name."
He thinks about that for a moment, tries to figure out what went wrong, and scowls.
He scowls at you, and gestures for you to continue.
"Chafblum is father of @Guoblum. And Chafblum is a lizard-wrestler. Two jobs, very much same."
"No, he is not! Chafblum is chief of Disquiqui tribe!"
"Shaddup. Chafblum did not ask you." He whacks the native with his wooden spoon. "Chafblum is modest lizard-wrestler."
"Daddy Chafblum is greatest chief in all the valley."
His scowl grows deeper. "Chafblum has never seen that woman before in his life."
"Chafblum knows nothing of tribes. Especially this one."
"Who? Oh, right, Moctasomething, the Nahuatla guy.
Glad he left - he was no fun."
He's here somewhere... always sitting around moaning about being exiled."
"Chafblum makes great Pulque. Guoblum drinks it all. Guoblum is a greedy lizard."
"Your words call up strange memories, as if Chafblum once lived far away, under different name..."
He blinks, then whacks you with his wooden spoon. "Stop that. It is distracting."
"Paddle?  There is a paddle here, somewhere..."
He looks around, but appears to be having trouble focusing very far, and quickly gives up.
"You want paddle, go find one yourself!"
"Guoblum is daughter of Chafblum. Smile at the strangers, Guoblum."
"Yoo hoo! Jimmy Malone! Come sit next to best girl, Guoblum!"
"Yoo hoo! Guoblum! Go swimming in river full of piranhas! Take flying leap at rolling dinosaur!"
"Oh, @Jimmy is no fun."
"Yoo hoo! Handsome stranger! Come sit next to Guoblum."
"Leave Guoblum alone, stranger. Guoblum is great beauty, but is not for you. Guoblum is marrying another stranger, called @Jimmy Malone."
"Why, there is Jimmy Malone!" He points at Jimmy. "How did Jimmy get out of hut?"
"Why, don't you remember, Chafblum-old-pal? You got drunk and decided that $P here would be a much better husband for Guoblum, and you let me out."
"Did Chafblum do that? Must have; Jimmy Malone is free." He turns to you. "Ready for wedding?"
"Wait! Jimmy Malone is big liar! Let $P find his own woman. Guoblum is for Jimmy Malone."
"Sorry, stranger. Guoblum's mind is set. Find own woman."
"Stupid name, Jimmy Malone. Skinny stranger. Jimmy Malone now in prison hut here in village."

He looks around for the prison hut, but his eyes refuse to focus that far, so he gives up.
"Disquiqui feed him up so he will be fit mate for daughter Guoblum."
"Disquiqui shaman is called Larrifin." He shouts: "Larrifin! Where is Larrifin?"
"He's not here!
"Too bad. Larrifin is not here."
"You want drums? Go to Tuomaxx. Best drum-maker in all Disquiqui village."
"Chafblum banished him, remember?"
"Shaddup! Who asked you?"
"Yes, Chafblum banished Tuomaxx. Long story. Want to hear long story?"
"$P did well. Can hear Sharptooth in plenty of time to run away."
"Will join $P's union of tribes, when the time comes."
He whacks you with his spoon. "Talked about that already! Must put noise-maker on @Sharptooth."
He puts the bowl of his wooden spoon on your chest. "Look here. Stain." When you look, he brings it up to whack your nose. "Fooled you, $P!"
"Want to unite Disquiqui with other tribes? Tried that once. $P failed test of bravery. Want to try again?"
He pulls out a big jug filled with whitish fluid and looks at you expectantly.
"Sharptooth is big lizard. Bigger lizard even than Larrifin over there."
"Larrifin heard that!"
"Sharptooth lives southeast of village most of the time. Eats Disquiqui warriors and sleeps it off rest of the time."
"Want more plachta?"
"Too bad! Get your own."
"Then why you ask?" He whacks you with his jug of plachta.
"Ahhh, riddance is good."
"Chafblum doesn't know anything about $Z."
Jimmy has been frantically writing all this down in his @notebook as everyone has been speaking. "It was a severe test of my masterful shorthand speed, $P-old-plachta-fiend, but I got it."
Jimmy speaks up. "Tell you what, boss. It could be that we're going to have a lot of these little chores ahead of us. I'll note down what each chief wants."
"Any time you want to check out what we've got in store for us, ask me about my @notebook. It never forgets."
"You want to make alliance with Disquiqui and other tribes? Keep other tribes from humiliating -- "
"Attacking!"
" -- attacking Disquiqui all the time? Yes, will gladly join alliance!"
"Wait! Must always strike bargain first. Traditional way. Demand test of virtue, test of bravery, test of skill."
"Larrifin is right. Cannot join alliance until you pass three tests." He gives you a close look and turns back to Larrifin. "Two tests. This one never pass test of virtue."
"True. Two tests enough. Bravery and Skill."
"First test. Bravery."
He pulls up a big jug of a clotted white liquid.
"Called 'plachta.' You must sample its smooth and delicate flavor." Even from here, it smells like a paper mill having an early-morning belching duel with a stockyard.
"Time to test bravery. Brave enough to drink it?"
Do you drink from the jug of plachta?
Lifting the jug to your lips, you gamely swallow some of the harsh liquid. A cheer goes up from the crowd.
You shudder as the toxic goo crawls down your throat.
For a moment, you can't remember your name. Your legs and mouth go numb. Your eyes snap open and won't shut. You feel something like steam whistling out your ears and nose.
Then you go blind.
You hear Chafblum's voice: "Good plachta today!"
But your sight does return.
There is a low moan of disappointment from the crowd.
"You are big coward." Chafblum hits you with his spoon. "Go away." He turns away from you.
"What would be good test of skill?"
"Marrying Guoblum!"
"No, that is another test of bravery!"
Guoblum throws a double handful of fruit at the other woman.
"Wait! I know. This man must put noise-maker on @Sharptooth."
The crowd cheers.
"There is big lizard near here. Usually southeast of village. We call it Sharptooth. Stands tall like hut."
"Eats Disquiqui warriors. Wanders around staggering afterwards. But always comes back for more."
"For test of skill, must put noise-maker on Sharptooth so Disquiqui warriors can hear Sharptooth coming."
"Father, that would be stupid! If we hear Sharptooth coming, we might become frightened and run away!"
"Ignore her." He whacks her with his spoon.
"Larrifin, give him the noise-maker."
The shaman hands you a large copper bell, rather like a cow-bell.
"Put that on Sharptooth.
"But he's got too much stuff!"
"Go bother Larrifin about the @bell later, then. When you can carry it, put bell on Sharptooth.
Then we join alliance."
Guoblum begins sniffling. "Nice man will be all eaten up. Only a great warrior could hold @Sharptooth still to put noise-maker on it."
"Hmmm... daughter is right. $P is one dead warrior. Too bad."
"Spear of Shamap! Spear of Shamap!"
"Good idea! Shamap was strange member of Disquiqui. Not like the rest of us. Liked to pull teeth out of big lizards."
"Shamap would put big skin of plachta on point of spear and hit lizard with it. Lizard would fall down. Not surprising: So would Chafblum."
"Here is more plachta for Spear of Shamap. Don't use it up before you make spear."
"Larrifin doesn't have enough to do... Larrifin! Give warrior plachta when he can carry it."
The shaman grumbles, but nods in agreement.
"Enemy warrior named Nakola, of Barrab tribe, was scaring Disquiqui warriors to death. Tuomaxx went to Barrab tribe to teach them lesson."
"But Barrab chief is too wily for Tuomaxx."
"So are most trees."
"Shaddup. Barrab chief use magics to steal Tuomaxx' mind away. Makes Tuomaxx happy, since he didn't like mind anyway."
"When Tuomaxx comes home, he has lost mind and not avenged scaring of Disquiqui warriors. Stops feasting and drinking with other Disquiqui."
"Just builds drums and flutes and sings to himself. So, to make long story short -- "
"Too late."
"Shaddup. -- Chafblum exiles him."
"Shame, too. Tuomaxx builds better drums and flutes than anyone. Think he is living on hill somewhere back east."
"Good choice."

description.text:
a Myrmidex soldier, bigger and glossier than the rest.
*

items.text: Its mandibles writhe and clack as it forces itself to speak something like the human tongue. "Not allowed here. Must die. Will ask Queen."
It cocks its head for about half a second. Then: "Queen agrees. Hive alerted. Meat-beings must die!"
"Talking again? Why still alive?" It waits a moment. "Queen confirms. Meat-beings must be chewed!"

description.text:
a large, raucous, especially colorful parrot.
*

items.text: "Ja, ja, ve haff vays of making you talk."

"Who's the pretty boy?
Who's the pretty boy?"
"Cleese, do shut up! You're driving me @mad! SQUAWK! Driving me @mad!"
"Eat the @cracker, Cleese! Eat the cracker, Cleese! SQUAWK!"
"It seems the only job you're capable of doing, @Fritz, is feeding your damned parrot."
"@SQUIRK!"
"@Chirrup!"
"@SKREE!"
"SQUAWK! @Chiurrrr SQUAWK!"
"@AWK!"
"@SQUAWK!"
"Ja, herr doktor. Ze Underground City of ze @Kotl sounds most impressive. SQUAWK!"
"But your plans: Zey are... not entirely rational. Zey sound almost... @insane. SQUAWK!"
"Eat the cracker, Cleese!"
The parrot speaks in a different voice: "We cannot easily say zuh-peck-tor. It is alien to our tongues. SQUAWK!"
"While you remain among the Nahuatla, you will be known as Zipactriotl. SQUAWK! Who's the pretty boy?"
"I tell you, Fritz, the lost civilization of these Kotl may have been the most magnificent ever known!"
"Where's the cracker? Cleese, shut up!"
"Their city is AWK! amazing. What calamity could have destroyed them?"
"Mad he calls me, mad!"
"Fritz, there's no room in my @plans, in my world of the future, for a doubter such as yourself!"
"SQUAWK! I'll never allow you to see my @city! Get out! Let the dinosaurs chew your bones!"
"Good Lord, $P! That's Johann @Spector's voice!"
"Conquer the Earth, Conquer the Earth!"
"Cleese, stop repeating SQUAWK! everything I say or it'll be parrot soup for lunch!"
The parrot stares at you expectantly.
The parrot looks at you disbelievingly. "With a @jaguar?"
"Well, they are kind of nice..."
"Spam spam spam. SQUAWK! Humbug."
"Hold the anchovies!"
"@Fizz!"
"@Plop!"
"I like the black ones... especially when they're puppies."
"Ja, ja, shut up! Just shut up!"
"Cleese, if you're going to squawk, squawk in English!"
"Crunchy frog! Crunchy frog!"
"Alphabet soup!"
"New girls! New madam! SQUAWK! But the same old customers!"
"$Z! SQUAWK!"
"SQUAWK! $Z!"
"Parrot joke! AWK!"
"Caudal! Cattle! AWK! Kettle!"

description.text:
a muscular, enormous, muscular, unkempt, muscular man.
*

items.text: "You! Darden trampled you into the earth once before. Now Darden will be sure you will stay there!"
"It is the $P! You have cost Darden much. Darden is not chief of Urali. You did this! You must die!"
"It is the $P again! Has Darden not chased you before him? Why do you return? Only to die!"

description.text:
a lean, thoughtful-looking, pale-skinned native man.
*

items.text: "It seems there is a visitor. Visitor or invader? We will find out. What does the stranger want?"
From his belt-pouch, he pulls a piece of charcoal and a scrap of hide from which all hair has been scraped.
He frowns slightly, looking at
Aiela, and begins sketching her,
you, and begins sketching you,
his hand moving in bold, deft strokes of the charcoal.
"Once again Denys sees his most colorful visitor."
"Denys. Some say, 'Denys the Enlightened'; others," he looks disappointed, "say 'Denys the Weak.'"
"And how does Denys's visitor call himself?"
"Denys is a painter. Denys sees pictures in his mind and puts them on the walls of caves, on pieces of hide, on leaves, on whatever is at hand."
He continues sketching as he talks to you.
"Denys is a member of the @hidden Urali tribe... though he is an @outcast now."
"Denys knows that the beauteous Aiela has had unwanted attentions from Darden of the Urali tribe. This is no doing of Denys's."
"Aiela bears no ill-will toward Denys, then."
"Not long ago, when Darden came to power, Darden took and hid the statue of the Great Fabozz, a spirit sacred to the Urali."
"Darden told Denys to draw upon the cliff a mighty painting, one which would show @Fabozz going with Darden of his own will."
"Denys refused, and then Denys had to run for Denys's life, for Darden was not happy."
"The Urali stay hidden from all the other tribes of the Valley of @Eodon. Is Denys's visitor asking because he wishes to learn where the Urali live?"
"The Great Fabozz is a mighty spirit of this land."
"This whole land, all the world, is called the Valley of Eodon."
"Fare well, colorful visitor."
"Denys does not know about that."
He finishes his sketching, compares his result to the model, and shows it to you. Though the technique is crude, it is a recognizable drawing of
the lovely Aiela.
He hands the piece of hide to you. "A gift for Denys's visitor. Remember Denys well."
your features.
He hands the piece of hide to you. "A gift for Denys's visitor. Remember Denys well."
"$A. An odd name. As strange and distant-seeming as he who carries it."
"Denys sees that $A has among his friends the beauteous Aiela, bright flower of the Kurak tribe."
Aiela gives him a sardonic little nod. "Denys is well-spoken... for a member of the @Urali tribe."
Denys's face becomes a little more guarded. "Denys is sorry, but even outcast, he is still of the Urali. Denys will not say where the Urali live."
"Denys's heart is made happy to hear it."

description.text:
a giant stone head with luminescent green stone eyes.
*

items.text: As the bright flash from your light floods the cave, there is a second, brighter flash.
And when it fades...
Fabozz is gone!
A deep, sepulchral voice rumbles around you, moaning a single word: "Light." The voice fades, and silence returns.
A sharp wind whips through the stone chamber.
From deep caves and tunnels comes the sound of frogs croaking, rising in volume... and gradually, eerily forming SPOKEN WORDS.
"$P," croak the voices. "You have restored the Great Fabozz to his true place, where the sun may again reach him."
The frog-croaking becomes deeper and more random for a moment, then settles down again into words.
"$P is friend to the Great Fabozz and all the Urali. Let every Urali warrior carry word of what he has done."
"Henceforth, $P and all he counts as friends may pass unharmed through Urali lands. The mighty lizard which guards the Urali village will do you no harm."
"Darden's influence is no more."
"The Great Fabozz commands that Wamap the Shaman become chief."
"$P, the spirit-winds say that you seek the one called Aiela. You will find her in the cave to the south of the Urali village. The guards will not stop you."
"All is well. The Great Fabozz is content." The croaking and chirping of the frogs becomes louder and more random, then dies down and silence returns.
The stone face looks at you enigmatically. You hear a lone frog croaking somewhere out in the mists, but the Great Fabozz does not address you.

description.text:
a strong-looking blond man in tattered Earth clothes.
*

items.text: "Mein Gott! It is a civilized man! Another outer-world man trapped in zis primordial hole. Velcome to Hell, stranger."
"Ah. It is ze Earth-Hero-Gone-Native." He snorts.
"I am Fritz von Hundlaben. I am from Munich."
"Ja? Wvat?"
He smiles mockingly. "I am ze world's worst chooser of employers. Actually, I am an archaeologist."
"Until recently I vas assistant to Dr. Johann @Spector. Not a real job, but an amazing simulation."
"Ja, Spector. A brilliant man. Archaeologist, anthropologist, geologist. I vent on many digs vith him. And it is my @fault zat he went mad."
"Haff I not told you uf the crystal brain before? Spector thought it wvas zome kind uf memory device. But then, Spector wvas a loon."
Rummaging in his pockets for a moment, he pulls out a strange crystalline device. "I haff no idea why @Spector called this a brain."
"I asked him wvy he did, und he said a great many things dot made no sense wvatsoever.
Here, perhaps you vill be able to figure it out." He hands you the device.
I wvould giff it to you, but you haff no place to carry it."
"Ja. It vas zis human-like hand made of gold. Very valuable. But he took it vis him somevere, I believe.  He said he intended to put it back wvere it came from."
"I found a gold head once, but @Spector took it from me."
"Ja, I haff zome rifle ammunition in my cave. No rifle -- Johann destroyed it wven I called him ein fruitcake."
He looks around and sees the rifle in your gear. "I see you could probably use some. Help yourzelf to it. But remember me if you find ze way out of zis jungle sewer."
"Ja, there are many native tribes in zis vicinity. Pindiros to ze southeast of my cave, Barako to ze southwest. Others to ze far south."
"Ve didn't get along wven I first came here, but I haff convinced them zat I am a worthy warrior. Zey don't know anything about boxing here. Now I am highly respected."
"Nein, nein, I vill just stay around here. This way I know I wvont run into @Spector again.
"Vell, return wvenever you wish. It is quite a treat for me to speak to a civilized human being."
"Pardon? My English is not so good."
"I haff told you zis long story already. Are you sure you vant to hear it again?"
"Vell, if you vish."
"Gut. It vas a long, long story ze first time."
He sighs. "I vas on a dig in Guatemala. I found zome rocks. Black, charred rocks wvich I did not recognize. Much later, back in Germany, I showed zem to Dr. @Spector."
"Johann grew very interested in zem. Said zey contained interesting radiant energies. Wrote many of his colleagues about zem."
Prof. Rafkin interrupts gently: "I can attest to the veracity of that statement, $P."
"Good to see you, Professor Rafkin. Ja, I know you by reputation."

"Anyvay, I visited him von day wven he had ze stones hooked up to some sort of funny battery apparatus. He vanted to show me wvat he could do vith the stones now. He said zey created strange ripples in ze fabric of time und space."

"He surprised even himself zis time. He began to channel power from ze stones, and suddenly zis black... door, I guess it vas... descended upon us. Brought us here." He gestures around, encompassing all the valley.
"Anyvay... I did all ze work, trying to hunt food and protect us from hostile @natives, wvile he tried to reverse ze process zat brought us here."
"But he gradually changed. Stopped trying to escape. Started trying to track down the source of other energy emissions."
"Von day, he vent avay, vas gone for veeks. He came back vith a mad light in his eyes, and a thing he called a crystal @brain."
"He said he had found zis underground city, far to ze southvest, und zis brain vas proof of ze vonders he had seen. He had zese plans to use ze energies he had mastered to conquer ze Earth."
"Zo, I told him he vas a nutcase, und he told me to leave. I ran away, vith all our supplies, @ammunition, und the @brain, und came here. Ze @natives seem to like me here."

description.text:
an aged, sly-looking Neanderthal man.
*

items.text: The Neanderthal peers nearsightedly at you; his nostrils flare. "New smell. Strange smell. Not scared. Not mad. What wants new smell?"
"Smell of $P in air. Does $P have shield?"
"Smell of $P in air. Grugorr greets $P."
He pounds on his chest proudly. The concussion dislodges small rocks from the cave ceiling. "Grugorr."
"Chief. Chief of Haakur. Protect Haakur from @Jukari and @spiders."
"Haakur tribe. Strongest. Live caves. Other tribes stupid: Build weak caves. Ha!"
"Jukari build huts outside. Stupid. Live where hot rock rivers run. Stupid! Attack Haakur. STUPID!"
"Spider cave south, along cliff. Full of spiders. Full of webs. Shield of Krukk there."
"Kill spiders. Destroy @webs. Bring shield of Krukk to Grugorr. Then Grugorr make ally with other tribes."
"Not matter. Spiders all dead."
"Spiders live cave south. Full of @webs. Big spiders. Come at night. Eat Haakur. Too fast for Haakur. Too smart for Haakur."
He looks very sad. "Grugorr had son @Krukk. Krukk went kill spiders. Not came back. Krukk dead."
"Webs too sticky. Can't break. Can't hurt. Just sticky."
"Grugorr heard torches hurt webs. Haakur no have torches. Torches hurt Haakur."
"Grugorr gave word. $P kept word.  Killed spiders. Brought shield. Haakur will join $P union of tribes."
"Uh? Unite? Help weaker tribes? No."
He peers at you thoughtfully. "Maybe."
He thinks about it some more. "Not like Jukari. But not like spiders even more."
"Go kill spiders. Go destroy webs. Go find shield where spiders and webs are. Shield was Krukk's. @Krukk dead. Get shield, prove spiders dead. Bring shield to Grugorr."
"Do, and Grugorr unite, even with Jukari."
He looks sad. "Krukk was son of Grugorr. Brave warrior. Went kill spiders. Spiders kill Krukk."
"Go."
"Grugorr not care."
Jimmy has been scribbling in his @notebook. "How about this: 'The hideous simulacrum of a man had little difficulty communicating with $P, his equal in intellect and charisma."

" 'He told $P that he wanted a nest of giant spiders -- the local equivalent of a violent street gang -- removed from the picture, their webs rubbed out, and a leather shield -- souvenir of the bloody task -- returned to him.'"
"I got all that, $P-old-pal."
Jimmy speaks up. "Tell you what, boss. It could be that we're going to have a lot of these little chores ahead of us. I'll note down what each chief wants."
"Any time you want to check out what we've got in store for us, ask me about my @notebook. It never forgets."
He peers closely at your gear.
He twists his lip in irritation and pretends to ignore you.
He draws back. "No shield of Krukk. Go away."
He points at you. "Have brought shield of Krukk. Good." He takes the shield from you.
"Grugorr is glad. Spiders dead. No Haakur be eaten now. Haakur will join with $P union."
He points at $Y. "Have brought shield of Krukk. Good." He takes the shield.
"Grugorr is glad. Spiders dead. No Haakur be eaten now. Haakur will join with $P union."

description.text:
a drunken, monstrously overweight, friendly woman.
*

items.text: "Ho! Handsome man. Perhaps he will stay with us." She gives you a flirtatious look over the rim of the bowl she is drinking from. "The Disquiqui need more good, strong men among us."
"(Hic) Greetings again! Perhaps $P will have some pulque."
She indicates herself. "Guoblum." She pronounces it GWO-blum.
"Yes? What does strange warrior want?"
She has to think about that. Then she brightens up. "Drinking @pulque! Guoblum also dances. Guoblum is chief's daughter. Guoblum will soon be bride of @Jimmy Malone."
"Guoblum belongs to Disquiqui tribe. Disquiquis are the happiest tribe." She smiles and takes another drink from her bowl.
"@Chafblum is chief of Disquiqui. @Larrifin is shaman. @Lerei is best friend of Guoblum. @Tuomaxx is drum-maker. No, wait, Tuomaxx is gone."
Another partygoer cuts in: "Friend! Lerei hates Guoblum."
"That was Lerei. Joking, of course."
"Jimmy Malone? Guoblum knows the name of Jimmy Malone. Jimmy Malone will soon be Guoblum's mate. We will be wed when this celebration ends."
Jimmy speaks up, whispering: "Lucky for me, celebrations NEVER end around here."
Guoblum smiles sweetly. "Guoblum heard that, mate-to-be Jimmy. Chafblum will call a halt in celebration when Guoblum is ready to marry Jimmy."
"Lerei is friend of Guoblum. Poor, sad thing. Skinny like tree, ugly like lizard."
"So says Guoblum, from whom the lizards run in fear!"
"That was Lerei. Brave girl. Pretends not to be hideous."
"Pulque." She offers you a sip from her bowl. "Pulque is very very very very good."
It smells like celery that has been out in the sun for a few days too many. Do you drink it?
"Guoblum's father is Chafblum. Wisest man in all the world. He is chief of Disquiqui. Brews the best pulque in all the world."
"Guoblum remembers Tuomaxx. No, she doesn't. Yes, she does. (Hic!)"
"Tuomaxx is of Disquiqui tribe. Round warrior. All pulque in village would not make him drunk. Makes drums. Hits tribesmen with drumsticks."
"Makes 'bonk' noise when hitting warriors. Very strange. Tuomaxx is exile now. Lives on hill somewhere east."
"Larrifin. Shaman of Disquiqui. Very bald and old. Guoblum would not marry him." She bats her eyes at you.
"Hey, boss, looks like you've got a special new friend..."
"Guoblum is just trying to make Jimmy Malone jealous! Jimmy Malone has no sense."
"Guoblum remembers Myrmidex. Ugly warriors from far away. Don't drink pulque. Don't dance. Guoblum doesn't like them."
She doesn't even notice you turning away from her.
"Guoblum does not know about that."
The taste of the stuff jolts through you, clears your sinuses, burns your throat, causes ringing in your ears, and brings tears to your eyes.
And it TASTES like celery that has been out in the sun for a few days too many.
Guoblum smiles sweetly. "Very mild batch. Ask Guoblum's father for the good stuff."
She draws back, looking disappointed. "Make Guoblum sad. Perhaps she will offer you nothing else." She bats her eyes at you coquettishly.

description.text:
a weary, handsome native woman with regal bearing.
*

items.text: Her eyes grow wide as she sets sight on you and your companions. "It is $P, the rescuer of Halisa! When Halisa returned to the village, she told Halawa of $P."
"Halawa, Queen of the Barako, owes $P a great debt for rescuing Halisa from the giant ape-thing. Come: $P must talk with Halawa."
"Spirits' blessings on the stranger," she says. She looks sad and distracted.
She looks eagerly at you and those around you, and then seems to slump. "The warrior from beyond has not found young Halisa. So it is. What does the warrior want now?"
"Spirits blessing on $P, who saved Halisa from the giant ape-thing.
"Ah. It is the strange warrior from beyond.
What does $P wish from the Barako queen?"
"Halawa, mother of @Halisa."
"Yes?"
"Halawa is queen of the Barako tribe. Her daughter @Halisa will be queen in times to come."
"Halawa belongs to the Barako tribe, Mountain-Dwellers of the North."
"Halisa is Halawa's daughter... as $P already knows. $P rescued Halawa from the horrid ape-thing."
"Halisa is Halawa's daughter. But Halisa has been seized and carried away."
"A gigantic ape-thing, bigger than any warrior, lives on a ledge north of the Barako village, near the river."
"Not long ago, it came down off its ledge and seized Halisa, carrying her away."

"Halawa's warriors sometimes see them upon the ledge, but can never climb up to the ledge. We do not know when the ape-thing will choose to harm Halisa, to dash her to death..." A tear trickles down her cheek.
"There is an old shaman who bears that name. Topuru lives on a small island just west of the Barako village. Topuru talks like one sun-touched."
"Halawa knows of the Myrmidex. They live to the south, fierce ant-things. Halawa fears that if they destroy the tribes to the south, they will next move against the Barako."
"Unite? Tribes unite? Why would we wish to do that? We have old hatred with the other tribes, especially the @Pindiro."
"Still... $P has rescued Halisa. Halawa owes $P a great debt of gratitude. For rescuing Halisa, Halawa will unite her tribe with the others... even the Pindiro."
"Unite? Tribes unite? Never. There is old hatred between the tribes, especially between Barako and Pindiro."
A shadow crosses her face. "Still... Halawa would unite with other tribes, even Pindiro... for the warrior great enough to bring her daughter @Halisa back to her."
"The Pindiro run the plains and stay away from the mountain slopes. They live far north and east of the Barako, in a village by the lake."
"Spirits bless you, $P-rescuer-of-Halisa."
She gives you a distracted little gesture of goodbye and turns somberly to other thoughts.
"Halawa knows nothing of this."
Jimmy whips out his @notebook. "Got it, boss."
Jimmy speaks up. "Tell you what, boss. It could be that we're going to have a lot of these little chores ahead of us. I'll note down what each chief wants."
"Any time you want to check out what we've got in store for us, ask me about my @notebook. It never forgets."

description.text:
a cute, energetic teenaged native girl.
*

items.text:
"This great, strange warrior has come to rescue Halisa!"
Delighted, she runs up and gives you a brief hug.
"Come!  Halisa will race strange warrior to Barako village. Halisa knows fastest way.  Will even wait until warrior is out of sight to give warrior a head start!"
"Halisa sees the mighty warrior and rescuer, $P the Great!"
"Halisa." She seems both shy around and fascinated by you.
She smiles shyly at you and nods.
"Halisa is learning to be queen of the Barako tribe, as her @mother is."
"Halawa is queen of the @Barakos, and is Halisa's mother."
"There are two tribes in the north. One is Halisa's own tribe, the @Barakos, south of where the mighty hunter rescued Halisa."
"There are also the @Pindiro, who are further north, near the waterfall lake."
"Oh, and there is mad @Topuru."
"Topuru is a shaman who lives alone on an island, west of the Barako village. But Topuru is not a whole tribe."
"Halisa knows little of the Pindiro tribe. We have fought with them for as long as Halisa can remember. Halisa does not understand why."
"Halisa belongs to the Barako tribe. The Barako live on the plains in the northern part of the valley."
"Candy? What is candy?"
"That is a question for the queen, Halawa; Halisa doesn't know."
"Oh. Well, perhaps you will talk with Halisa later."
"Halisa does not know about that."

description.text: a rather sullen, jewelry-bedecked Nahuatla man.

items.text: The man looks at you with contempt.
"You may not speak with Huitlapacti until you have received permission from Zipactriotl, you scabrous dog," he says, then ignores you.
The man's sullen, disinterested eyes briefly fix on you. "What do you want, insignificant one?"
"Shake and cringe before the thunder and majesty of my name. I am Huitlapacti." (He pronounces it wheat-la-PACK-tea.)
"Huitlapacti, the ruler of all I behold, vanquisher of the enemy, destroyer of the weak, master of the brutes of the forests and plains."
He scowls at you. "'Job'? Do you imagine that I  perform labor? I am the king! I rule. I dominate. I conquer."
"I scatter lesser men, such as yourselves, as corn before the reaping-blade."

A thought appears to penetrate his consciousness. "Wait. You are not one of my subjects. You have not shown me proper deference. You have not knelt before me, nor licked clean the dusty soles of my feet!"
"You must die. Guards! Kill this man!"
Huitlapacti glances at you, then his eyes widen in amazement. "$P, I did not fully understand the depths of your arrogance."
"You return here when you know I can cut you down with a clap of my hands, with a cough, with a harsh look!"
"It is time for you to die; do not even attempt to flee. Guards! Destroy this fool!"

description.text:
a sharp-eyed matriarch with greying hair.
*

items.text: "Another @stranger. Word has reached the Pindiro that such a warrior roams the valley. What does the stranger want among the Pindiro?"
"The warrior comes before us. Welcome, $P."
"It is $P come before us again. What does $P wish?"
"The warrior addresses Inara."
"Inara is queen of the Pindiro @tribe."
"The Pindiros are plains-runners. We live free on the open plains, hunting @beasts of the field and @fish of the water."
"Our enemies are the @Barakos."
"The Pindiro are the best hunters of the plains. Pindiro warriors are strong and tireless."
"Many of our people pull fish from the rivers, and paddle @rafts out into the great lake to hunt the larger fish that live there."
"It is dangerous to go into the great lake without a raft and four people with @paddles. The creatures under the water will eat any warrior they find swimming."
"The Disquiqui make our paddles. They are a strange tribe, far to the south."
"The Barakos live to the west and south. They dwell on the slopes of the mountain. They come into Pindiro territory too often; we beat them back."
"West of the Pindiro village, along the northern cliff face, is a cave where lives a strange man... a man as strange as he whom Inara now addresses."
"His skin and clothes are odd. He fights without spear or knife, but only with clenched fists. Yet no Pindiro warrior can stand before him."
"Inara knows of one with that name. An old shaman. Topuru lives on a small island west of the @Barako village."
"Inara has already decided to join $P's union of tribes."
"The strange warrior wishes to unite the tribes? This warrior has seen his mind laid low by the sun." She laughs at you.
Then she thinks about it. "Strange warrior, the Pindiro fight many brave enemies, such as the Barakos. This is our way of life."
"But many good warriors die in this constant fighting. Inara might be willing to trade one way for the other."  She thinks a while longer.
"Inara will accept a union of tribes."
"$P Peace-Bringer is welcome here. $P may return any time."

items.text: "You are returning to wakefulness. It is good."
"Intanya's potion is powerful magic. It has granted you the speech of the people of this valley. Now you may understand what is said to you."
"In fevered ravings, you spoke much of @Aiela, our chieftain's daughter, as well as a @Rafkin and a @Jimmy. Intanya thinks you must find them as soon as possible."
"But the valley is full of danger. Before Intanya can let $P rise again and search for his comrades, Intanya must ask $P a question, to see if his mind has healed as well as his body."
"The spirits tell Intanya that someone here is unwell."
"Intanya is pleased to see $P returned unharmed."
"Intanya is pleased to see $P and $P's friends returned unharmed."
"Intanya rejoices to see $P awake again. $P was very hurt when Intanya's men found him. Intanya's men have brought $P here for healing."
"Your wounds are healed, but I must know if your memory is intact. I have drawn the question from your own memory, so it is in your own words."
"Long has the name Intanya been borne.&
"Intanya is shaman to the Kurak tribe. Intanya consults the @spirits; he also @heals the ill and injured."
The shaman gestures around him. "This is the Kurak tribe. Aloron is our chief; $P should go and speak with him."
"The Myrmidex are strange, fierce warriors. Insects of great size, they attack and kill our warriors without cause."

Shamuru interrupts: "It is true, $P. Shamuru has been long been a friend of Intanya, and helped Intanya in many things, though Shamuru is not of the Kurak tribe. Many other warriors do the same."

"Pinde is used to help guide spirits and produce visions."
"Strong flavor and smell. Brings light, calms animals, many other spells, when invoking the right spirits."
"Totems are used to invoke the spirits."
"Aphaz is the spirit of emotions, and strength."
"Motazz is the spirit of battle."
"That is the spirit of knowledge and visions."
His eyes narrow. "Intanya knows from his dreams that $P has been to dream-land called Britannia, and bears important title there. The dreams say $P is a mighty warrior and hero."
"Intanya knows more than that. Much more." There is laughter in his eyes, but he does not elaborate.
"Intanya has great powers of healing."
"Intanya knows much about magic, the invoking of @spirits to perform many kinds of magics. He has taught some of these to Triolo."
"There are many spirits in the Valley of Eodon: Spirits of trees and winds, spirits of animals and life."
"Intanya senses how the spirits feel and tells his fellows; Intanya draws on the powers of the spirits to @heal those who must be healed."
"Aiela is a great treasure. Intanya knows that her father is grateful to $P for returning her to the Kurak."
"Warriors search the valley for Aiela. The Urali are well hidden, and the spirits will not tell Intanya where they lie."
"And yet, the spirits do promise that someone will find her. You should speak with Aloron, our chieftain, if you wish to aid in the search."
"He is with $P now."
"Intanya has had dreams of one such. Search among the Disquiqui, far to the south; Intanya hears their drums and music when shown the face of Jimmy Malone in his dreams."
"The Disquiqui are happy people, but their shaman does not know much. They live far from here, west of the great stone city of the @Nahuatla."
"The Nahuatla call their stone city 'Tichticatl'. They are very proud of it. They live south of the @Yolaru village."
"The Yolaru are dark-skinned warriors. Their village is about a day's travel east of here."
"He is with $P now."
"Word has reached Intanya that one such stays with the Yolaru tribe, to the east."
"May the spirits protect you, $P Ava-Tar."
"$P must learn of $Z by himself."
Intanya throws back his head and closes his eyes. You can almost hear the voices of the spirits whispering in his ears.
Intanya opens his eyes. "No one here is in need of healing."

items.text: "Spirits' blessings on the strange visitor.& He looks at you closely. "The strange visitor from no known tribe.&
"Hail mighty $P, who returned to us the sacred hide!&
The chieftain's face lights up as he sees the sacred hide in $Y's inventory. "The sacred hide of the Jukari is returned!&
With obvious relief, he takes the hide and examines it carefully. Satisfied that it is undamaged, he carefully folds it and tucks it away.
"The Jukari owe you a great debt, mighty $P.&

"Spirits' blessings on $P.&
"Jumu the Fearless, Jumu the All-High.&
"Jumu is chief of the Jukari tribe. Jumu has been chief several days already.&
"And Jumu's first great task has been accomplished, by Jumu's great friend $P: The sacred hide is returned to Jumu's people.&

Rafkin says: "You know, my boy, I once knew a man by the name of James Wildman.  He used to tell a story about using a fire extinguisher to cross the superheated deck of a burning ship.&
"While lava is considerably hotter, this technique might still prove viable. Chances are that the lava will re-melt fairly quickly, though.&
"I had a fire extinguisher in my lab.&
"You know, I'd bet old Rafkin would know something about this kinda stuff...&
"We have not yet chosen a @shaman to care for the sacred hide, which you returned to us.&
"The sacred hide is important to our people. And with no @shaman, the Jukari need it even more.&
"If $P could find a way to the @cave and bring back the sacred hide, the Jumu would be greatly in $P's dept.&
"We have no shaman. Old shaman died when mountain spirits became angry and threw stones down on him.&
"He who wants diamonds and emeralds of the Jukari must go to the sacred @cave.&
"Unite? Unite with other tribes? Jumu does not like to fight other tribes.&
"Since $P has brought the sacred hide back to the Jukari, Jumu will ally himself with $P and $P's union of tribes.&
"If... the strange warrior were to retrieve the Jukari's sacred @hide, Jumu would join the warrior's union of tribes.&
"Walk with the spirits' blessing, oh $P, friend of the Jukari.&
"Walk with the spirits' blessing, strange one.&
"Jumu does not understand that.&
"The @cave itself is full of diamonds and emeralds. You may take diamonds from the cave, if you can reach it," the chief adds hopefully.
Jimmy whips out his notebook. "Get across lava flow and bring back a holy throw-rug. Sounds like a heap o' laughs. I've got it written, boss.&
Jimmy speaks up. "Tell you what, boss. It could be that we're going to have a lot of these little chores ahead of us. I'll note down what each chief wants.&
"Any time you want to check out what we've got in store for us, ask me about my @notebook. It never forgets.&

items.text: "Greetingss to the visitor." The thing's accent is strange, but its words are understandable.

Prof. Rafkin reaches out to touch the reptile, but his hand goes clean through it.

"When the Myrmidex rebelled against the Kotl and fled, the Kotl needed new sservantss. Katalkotl led a force of Kotl out into the world to find those sservantss."

"The Myrmidex were bred from antss. The Kotl thought that the Myrmidex might inherit the industriouss nature of the antss. But the Myrmidex also inherited the warlike nature of the antss."
"The Myrmidex left the Kotl city, taking with them the giant black sstone which @powerss the city. The city continuess to draw power from the sstone, though it is far away."

"The automatonss are like sstatues... but made to walk and talk through a mysstic power."

"Then I will not sspeak it."
"Perhapss you will visit them later, then."
"Near where you entered the city, there is a cluster of transportation plates. Step onto the south central plate."
"You will find yourself in the southern portion of the city. Walk east and then south as far as you can."

"It can be confusing... you may find it easiest to ssimply follow the left wall."

"The Kotl built this city. Unlike you, they were desscended of reptilian ancesstorss. They looked much like me."
"From their earliesst timess, they were in possession of a huge black sstone. Their mysstics learned to draw powerss from the sstone."
"With those powerss, they built this city, and lit it, and made the automatonss to sserve them."
"They could not power enough automatonss to sserve them, so they ssought to breed a race of sservants. This ressulted in the Myrmidex."
"The Myrmidex left and took the black sstone with them, but the city sstill had power, drawing it from the sstone at a great distance."
"The Kotl needed new sservantss, so they ssent out the hero Katalkotl into the outer world. Katalkotl brought back many humanss to be sservants."

"The Myrmidex killed and killed. Perhapss some Kotl ssurvived to esscape; I do not know. The Myrmidex left, and the city clossed up behind them. Sso hass it been until the sstrangers came -- you, and the other @sstranger."

"I am of the Nahuatla."
"They told me that I should stop killing my own officers. I told them, 'Nobody tells me that!' and killed THEM."
"Then more came and said, 'Why did you do this?' And I said, 'I don't answer questions!' and killed THEM."
"Then more came, with nets, and I couldn't kill all of them. So I am here. But now you are here, you will have to @free me."
"Don't say 'No' to me. I might have to kill you, too. Instead, you should @free me."

"Good. Open the door. Hurry up." He steps back, feverish anticipation in his eyes.
He flushes very red, very angry. "Then I do not get to kill you myself. But the guards will." He begins screaming: "Guards! Guards!"
